This Ramadan special features Talat Syam and Humayon Jahangeer, who share practical guidance on the fundamental principles of Qur’anic recitation. The programme aims to help viewers refine their pronunciation, improve fluency, and deepen their connection with the Holy Qur’an during the blessed month of Ramadan.

0:00 Intro
2:56 Iqlab (conversion)
7:28 Izhaar Shafawi of Mim Sakin
11:06 Idgham Shafawi of Mim Sakin
14:26 Tafkheem of 'Ra' (Thick 'Ra')
18:21 Tarqeeq of 'Ra' (Thin 'Ra')
19:32 Common mistakes of the rules of 'Ra'
21:41 Stop signs in the Holy Qur'an
23:32 Waqf Lazim (Must Stop)
25:49 Waqf Mutlaq (Absolute Stop)
26:29 Waqf Jaiz (Permissible Stop)
27:32 Waqf Mujawwaz (Permitted or Allowed pause)
28:45 Waqf Murakhas (Licensed/Authorised Stop)
30:06 Qeela (better not to Stop)
31:06 Wa

ilQUFUWTr8w.about:
The arguments used by atheists and agnostics against the existence of God actually go against their claims; their arguments actually prove God’s existence. 

While so much is being said about a recent debate between Javed Akhtar (जावेद अख्तर جاوید اختر) and Mufti Shamail on God’s existence, this podcast delves into the fallacies committed in the name of science, rationality and common sense from the true Islamic perspective of the Ahmadiyya Muslim Community.

This podcast is a common sense based refutation of a so called common sense based rejection of God.

This episode does not shy away from challenging questions and aims to engage both believers and sceptics in a respectful, rational dialogue.

Whether you are questioning faith, exploring philosophy, or seeking deeper understanding, this conversation invites reflection rather than blind acceptance.
